text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion continues her preparations to return to Ireland next year. She's acting the same as ever, but there's a hint of tension in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that something is off with Fine Motion, an irritated Air Shakur confronts her angrily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's clear that Fine Motion has been using logic to suppress her desire to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But even after this exchange, she is intent on prioritizing her duties, declaring that she will find a way to deal with her individual feelings on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing Fine Motion's determination, I decide to watch over her until she's made sense of her emotions.
